]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)  # ignore the first numerical index column
    # Ensure the column is integer type as per target schema
    df['addr_state'] = df['addr_state'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the exact same schema ['addr_state'] as the target,
# we can simply concatenate (union) all source tables vertically.
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target table schema is ['addr_state'] with integer type, which is already ensured.

# Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_53/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
